Absorption Arts

Mega Man (Mega Man) learns to absorb and copy the Special Weapons of Robot Masters like Ice Man thanks to his Variable Weapon System/Weapon Copy System.

Power/Ability to:

Use absorption arts.

The power to utilize practices that are assimilative in nature. Variation of Supernatural Arts. Related to Consumption Arts. Not to be confused with Thief Arts.

Also Called[]

  • Assimilation/Assimilative Arts/Techniques

Capabilities[]

The user can utilize the Absorption Arts, a specialized system of techniques based around assimilative power. Absorption allows one to incorporate various types of targets into one’s body (energy, entities, matter, powers). Potent as this ability can be, specialized training can allow one access to unique skills based on it. One can learn to metabolize the absorbed targets to gain sustenance and/or enhanced vigor. Users can learn to replicate supernatural abilities and characteristics based on the assimilated objective (elemental essence, mythical might, matter-based power). Practitioners could even train to transcend their current state to higher levels of being through their integration skills, potentially attaining a state near or matching godhood. They may only be limited by how much they can and/or what they train to absorb.
